tenderSchedule.title: Providing pre-examination coaching for various Group - C Posts for Minority Community candidates at BENGALURU Division for the year 2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: Joint Director, (Minority Welfare Department is inviting online Short-Term e-Tender for providing pre-examination coaching for various Group - C Posts to Minority Community candidates at BENGALURU DIVISION for the year 2026-27 under two cover system / two parts (Technical and Financial Bid) from reputed and prestigious training institutions registered in India who have adequate resources and experience

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Minorities, Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C, Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder shall be bound by and shall strictly adhere to all terms, conditions, eligibility criteria and requirements specified in the tender document and any subsequent modifications issued by the competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have minimum 10 full time faculties with a minimum of 5 years teaching experience in Group C Civil Services examinations

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of faculty members along with Self declaration containing faculties name, address & qualification
Others -- certificate of experience issued by the coaching institutes
Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of faculty members as per Annexure-4
Others -- PF/PT/TDS/ESI & Offer letter of the faculty also to be uploaded under e- procurement portal
Valid ESI certificate
Valid EPF Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The candidates who have undergone (full time - complete course) training from the bidding coaching institute must be selected to the Dept. for Group C Services during the last 3 years/notifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish all the below documentary proof and details as per As per the format enclosed at Annexure-1
Others -- The result sheet of Students who have secured appointment in various posts of Group C Services Exams
Others -- Admission details of the students  studied  in  respective coaching institute, such as fee paid receipt/ institute id card.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have trained students through offline mode (full time complete course) for Group C or Equivalent examinations during the last 3 years. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Work Done Certificate
Satisfactory Performance Certificate
Others -- Details of the students as per  the  format enclosed at Annexure-2
Others -- Payment receipts of the students to the institutes/Institute ID Cards of the students to the institutes

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have an experience in Group C civil services pre- examinations training courses in the offline mode from the last 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration containing year  wise list of no. of trained candidates
Others -- registration copies if any or related registered document to prove the offline existence of the institute from past 3 years
GST Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institutions must have own set of study materials along with the content & also should have conducted its own exclusive test series for Group C Examinations (Karnataka State) for past 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- One set of own study material has to be submitted before the last date of submission of the tender
Others -- copies of the Study material & test series  should be uploaded under the e-procurement portal
GST Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidding firm should have its own Online Platform on Android or its own website accessible on windows OS and an app with downloads. Entire video lectures for each Subject wise, Chapter wise and concept wise should available to access. Online Test series with all the chapter wise test papers should be available in the online platform. Coaching Institution should have its own Online Management Information System (MIS) on candidates trained course wise, Centre wise, project wise with evaluation marks etc to enable Directorate to monitor the programs on line.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish the details of App on android or website details operational on windows OS
Others -- Documents regarding presentation of digital content should be uploaded in e-procurement of minimum 10-20 Pages.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a training center (owned or leased or rented) with Digital class room coaching, library, CCTV surveillance.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Submit the following building/location documents in case of rented premises.
Others -- proof of ownership or Valid lease/rental agreement
Others -- Geo-location (Google Maps link or coordinates)
Others -- GPS Photographs of premises (Exterior & Interior)
Others -- Details of classrooms and seating capacity
Others -- Availability of essential utilities (electricity, water, internet, washrooms)

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All documents, certificates, declarations and supporting records specified in the tender document shall be uploaded by the bidder along with the bid, in the prescribed format and within the stipulated timeline.
any other registered document & GST Reg Certificate.
Audited report, Turnover certificate certified by CA
Balance Sheet and P&L Accounts statements
Certificate of Incorporation/Registration certificate under society/Partnership deed
ITR filed for the last three years. UDIN Verification will be Mandatory

itemList.itemName: BENGALURU DIVISION - The Teaching Institute should quote course fee per candidate for Providing pre-examination Coaching for various Group - C Posts examination coaching. The course fee should be inclusive of Coaching charges, Supply of printed Text books and study materials / digital materials will be provided to candidates and all other applicable taxes.
